label: TP
reason: User input from HTTP header flows through doSomething() - the Base64 encode/decode roundtrip preserves the input - and becomes bar, which is concatenated into fileName controlling FileInputStream. The file read operation has no validation against TESTFILES_DIR, allowing path traversal. The XSS sink uses encodeForHTML but the file reading vulnerability is real.

evidence.note: header name captured as param and breaks loop
doSomething encodes/decodes preserving user input into bar variable
fileName constructed from TESTFILES_DIR + bar passed to FileInputStream
